New namespaced optional vendor parameter survives import; unsupported mandatory checker blocks eligibility.
A/kA/mA, rms/peak and mm/um conversions obey semantic units and exact bounded precision.
Overcurrent B and residual B never substitute; complete product TCC/standard/domain evidence required.
Interrupting capacity at wrong voltage/poles/DC/standard cannot match an AC requirement.
Fault before catalogue release pointer causes total rollback; restart sees old coherent release.
Fault while copying immutable closure rolls back snapshots/dependencies/pointer/receipt together.
Captured closure permits coherent project-local apply or explicit rejection; no dangling references.

Known adopted source revocation invalidates CURRENT claim independently of new-edition adoption; history immutable.
Technically valid unpriced product remains visible but cannot win a proved comparable-cost optimum as zero.
Offer validity uses explicit instant and interval; expired/offline stock cannot become a current quote.
Aggregate demand across circuits before pack/MOQ/increment/tier computation; report purchased surplus and installed quantity.
Pin FX/currency/tax/rounding editions and cost scope; incompatible bases block cheapest claim.
Offer change stales consumed economic proposal/report without changing technical selection or geometry.
Reject cheap product whose complete body/service/accessory envelope fails ELV6; never offset fit failure with price.
Module width alone cannot qualify depth/terminal/bend/removal fit; unknown geometry remains unresolved.
Exact edition/interface pair evidence required; reject cycles, missing modules and duplicate shared accessory quantities.
Main/bus/outgoing/N/PE/phase/reserve/accessory/thermal constraints checked on complete K0 candidate.
Candidate must satisfy declared normal/emergency/source-transfer domains; missing qualified simulation remains blocked.
Explain objective vector and non-dominated proven-feasible candidates; no hidden weighted safety tradeoff.
Timeout/cancellation/first feasible solution cannot become NO_SOLUTION_PROVEN or OPTIMAL_PROVEN.
USER_OVERRIDE retains reasons and violations; human selection cannot green a failed mandatory constraint.
Independent connections change design/selection/profile/trust generation after capture; reject stale apply atomically.
Replay same command/payload after freeze returns recorded outcome; different payload conflicts; new mutation rejected.
Fault in any affected owner writer rolls back whole apply; unsupported shared UoW blocks full configuration apply.
Trial candidate results cannot become CURRENT of applied project without real owner capture/publication.
Previously empty candidate scope gains product; economic proposal invalidated through selector membership.
Company overlay cannot overwrite vendor facts or applicable mandatory normative constraints.
K12 device/frame/backbox/door/wall constraints and real load bindings remain coherent under explicit acceptance.
K13 Matter/Thread and KNX/DALI variants remain distinct typed bindings; unknown certification/firmware blocks required claims.
Electrical/control/communication failures and local/manual fallback remain separate; comfort cannot override life safety.
Catalogue/project/import/export contain no runtime pairing credentials, private keys or cloud tokens.
OCR/photo/nameplate match is an inferred candidate; installed identity and ratings need explicit evidence.
Read-only shared snapshot preserves technical reproducibility but obeys offer-term/source-license export policy.
Oversize archives, path traversal, remote executable references and numeric bombs reject before activation.
Migration restart/rollback and new-schema reader boundaries preserve old selection regression contracts.
Whole grid/transformer/MDB/MCC/motor/ELV/emergency target project produces deterministic selected BOM, audit and dossier when actual owners are qualified.
